title: Shipyard prep file
description: The one file the prep run returns: the level, the group of each PR, the release notes and the report's words for the release PR's page. docs/prep-file.md explains each field.

format.description: The version of this format. Format 1 (with summary and risks as sentences) is no longer read: write format 2.

level.description: The level of the release, why, and an answer for each read-first flag in the facts.

bump.description: The semver level of the release.

reasons.description: Why this level, one sentence each.

flags.description: An answer for each read-first flag in the facts.

flag.description: The id of the flag, as the facts name it.

answer.description: What the prep run found, and what it means for the level.

groups.description: The group of each PR in the range: every PR in exactly one group. A group with no PRs may be left out.

notes.description: The release notes, for users: public text with no internal term, private link or file path.

title.description: The title of the release notes.

summary.description: One sentence of 140 characters or fewer.

name.description: A short name for the item, 2 to 4 words: the #releases post shows it in italics before the text. Every item outside the "Before you update" section has one.

text.description: The item, as users read it.

covers.description: The PRs in the range this item is about.

report.description: The release manager's words for the release PR's page, which a person who does not know how releases run reads in under a minute: the headline, what changes, could it break anything and how to go back. Nothing above the page's folds may hold a word of how releases run, a PR number, a commit, a file path or a config key.

headline.description: What the release does, 8 words or fewer. It follows the product and version in the page's heading.

ask.description: The paragraph of the Slack ask, written as a person asking a colleague to approve would write it: it starts with "This release", is 15 to 70 words of plain sentences, says what changes and what could go wrong, and holds no count of PRs or commits. The tool adds the greeting, the release PR's link, the sentence on the checks and the thanks. A cut asks for it; a prep file cut before it existed is read without.

changes.description: Each change a user sees, 5 at most: what they had before, what they have now, and a short label. A row may cover several PRs. Every PR a user can see is in some change's covers, unless the list is full.

before.description: What a person had or saw before this release, in plain words.

after.description: What they have now, in plain words. The column is already headed Now, so do not start with it.

label.description: The change in 2 to 4 words, such as "the mod page change": the page's Still needed row names it.

covers.description: The PRs in the range this change is about. They are named in the audit record, never above the folds.

safety.description: Could it break anything? The answer, 4 words or fewer, starting with an answer word (No, Not, Unlikely, Yes, ...), and one line of why, 25 words or fewer.

answer.description: The answer, 4 words or fewer, starting with its answer word.

why.description: Why, in one line of 25 words or fewer.

risks.description: What could go wrong and what then happens, one row each of the page's If | Then table. The tool adds the last row, how to go back.

if.description: What could go wrong, as the If cell reads it: "the release fails before the site updates".

then.description: What then happens, or what we do.

untested.description: Optional: why this case was not tested. The page shows it after the If text.

undo.description: How to go back: what a repo does (the tool names the version) and how long it takes. It is the last row of the If | Then table.

how.description: What going back is, in a few words that name no version: "we publish it again".

howLong.description: How long it takes, from the repo's real merge-to-live time: "About 20 minutes".

internal.description: Each change no user sees, 12 words or fewer: required when a PR is grouped Internal, left out when none is.

covers.description: The PRs in the range this item is about.

managerNotes.description: Notes for the person running the release (a paused run to approve, a step to run again). They are posted as a comment on the release PR, never in its body.

duringDeploy.description: Optional: what customers notice while the release goes out, one line of 15 words or fewer. The page shows it as its During the deploy row, only when this is set.

personSteps.description: Optional: each step after the merge that a named person runs or has agreed to run, 2 at most. The page shows each as an A person's step row, with the person's profile name.

who.description: The person's GitHub login, without an @. The page writes their profile name.

step.description: What the person does, starting with its verb, as the page reads after their name: "applies the Temporal settings, the last step".

state.description: to do: the person has not done it yet. agreed: the person has agreed to do it.

urgent.description: Optional: true only on a patch cut from the production tag to fix something broken now. The page adds " (urgent fix)" after the version in its heading. The lint refuses it on any other release.

text.description: Text with at least one character that is not a space.
